messages.subject: File for Input parameters
parts:
Dear all,

I wonder if there is any way to upload a file, load its data and modify the default INPUT parameters of a Shiny application.

If seen that in the uploading capability, one can load a file and transform its data in the OUTPUT section. But what about modifying the INPUT section?

I'm thinking in a INPUT profile file which stores input parameters. Shiny could load the file and modify the default input parameters. This is useful when a long list of parameters is required. See for instance:

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/campa/espectre/

All comments welcome.

Josep M.,
